005package org.wpilib.tunable.util;
006
007/** Path helper functions for tunable backends and registry internals. */
008public final class PathUtil {
009  private PathUtil() {
010    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
011  }
012
013  /**
014   * Normalizes a tunable table path by adding a leading slash, collapsing duplicate slashes, and
015   * adding a trailing slash.
016   *
017   * @param path input path
018   * @return normalized table path
019   */
020  public static String normalizeTableName(String path) {
021    path = normalizeName(path);
022    if (path.charAt(path.length() - 1) != '/') {
023      path = path + '/';
024    }
025    return path;
026  }
027
028  /**
029   * Normalizes a registry backend prefix.
030   *
031   * <p>Trailing slashes are removed, except for the root prefix.
032   *
033   * @param prefix input prefix
034   * @return normalized backend prefix
035   */
036  public static String normalizeBackendPrefix(String prefix) {
037    if (prefix.isEmpty()) {
038      return "";
039    }
040    String normalized = normalizeName(prefix);
041    while (normalized.length() > 1 && normalized.endsWith("/")) {
042      normalized = normalized.substring(0, normalized.length() - 1);
043    }
044    return normalized;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Normalizes a backend-owned prefix.
049   *
050   * <p>Unlike registry backend registration prefixes, this keeps a trailing slash so prefix-based
051   * removals can match only descendants when requested.
052   *
053   * @param prefix input prefix
054   * @return normalized prefix
055   */
056  public static String normalizePrefix(String prefix) {
057    return prefix.isEmpty() ? "" : normalizeName(prefix);
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Returns a child table path by adding a trailing slash when needed.
062   *
063   * @param path input path
064   * @return child table path
065   */
066  public static String childTablePath(String path) {
067    if (path.isEmpty() || path.charAt(path.length() - 1) != '/') {
068      return path + '/';
069    }
070    return path;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Normalizes a child name by collapsing path separators and removing a leading slash.
075   *
076   * @param name input name
077   * @return normalized child name
078   */
079  public static String normalizeChildName(String name) {
080    String normalized = normalizeName(name);
081    if (!normalized.isEmpty() && normalized.charAt(0) == '/') {
082      return normalized.substring(1);
083    }
084    return normalized;
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Normalizes a tunable path by adding a leading slash and collapsing duplicate slashes.
089   *
090   * @param path input path
091   * @return normalized path
092   */
093  public static String normalizeName(String path) {
094    if (!path.isEmpty() && path.charAt(0) == '/' && !path.contains("//")) {
095      return path;
096    }
097
098    StringBuilder normalized = new StringBuilder(path.length() + 1);
099    if (path.isEmpty() || path.charAt(0) != '/') {
100      normalized.append('/');
101    }
102    char previousChar = '\0';
103    for (int i = 0; i < path.length(); i++) {
104      char ch = path.charAt(i);
105      if (ch != '/' || previousChar != '/') {
106        normalized.append(ch);
107      }
108      previousChar = ch;
109    }
110    return normalized.toString();
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Returns whether a path is equal to a root path or is one of its descendants.
115   *
116   * <p>An empty root and "/" both match every path.
117   *
118   * @param path path to test
119   * @param root root path
120   * @return true if path is root or a descendant of root
121   */
122  public static boolean isPathOrDescendant(String path, String root) {
123    if (root.isEmpty() || "/".equals(root) || path.equals(root)) {
124      return true;
125    }
126    if (root.endsWith("/")) {
127      return path.startsWith(root);
128    }
129    return path.length() > root.length()
130        && path.startsWith(root)
131        && path.charAt(root.length()) == '/';
132  }
133}
